note_en: 一下 after a verb makes the action brief and casual: 检查一下口袋 "just check your pockets." English softens with words like "just," "quickly" or "take a look," but Chinese simply adds 一下 after the verb. It's very common in requests and advice because it sounds less demanding than the bare verb.
